title: Dark Ritual in the Desert
description: A colossal skeletal hand wearing a crown emerges from the ground, clutching a glowing white skull in front of a massive gothic castle built into orange desert dunes. In the foreground, a crowd of hooded figures in purple robes gathers in a stone amphitheater around two central robed figures, one with a horned skull mask and another holding a staff, under a pink swirling night sky with a black crescent moon.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy scene at night featuring a giant skeletal hand wearing an ornate crown and holding a glowing skull, emerging before a towering black gothic castle with purple windows set into rolling orange desert dunes. In the foreground, a large gathering of hooded figures in deep purple robes stands in a stone amphitheater lit by torches, with two central figures in black and white patterned robes, one wearing a horned skull mask. A leafless tree, swirling pink and purple sky with a black crescent moon and falling stars complete the ominous atmosphere.
